semantics: Budget templates over measured resources. They contain no default exchange rates, imputed costs, or claim that missing values are zero.

missingness_policy.scalarization_rule: no built-in scalar; any exchange rates or weights must be supplied and reported by the user

cost_accounting.shared_artifact_setup: charge once for each artifact_group_id in the selected panel
cost_accounting.per_model_feature_extraction: charge once for each model_revision and artifact_group_id
cost_accounting.per_protocol_head_fit: charge for each selected model_revision and evaluation_id
cost_accounting.per_protocol_evaluation: charge for each selected model_revision and evaluation_id

profiles.description: User-supplied wall-time, accelerator-time, memory, and storage limits over measured receipts.
Hard access/license filter for reuse of existing labeled artifacts, followed by user-supplied measured compute limits.
Includes new tissue, slides, annotation/pathologist labor, and direct billed cost; no protocol is eligible until constrained fields are measured or explicitly not applicable.
